experiences.summary: Maintain and extend a production-grade investment analytics platform used by student portfolio managers to evaluate performance, analyze time-series data, and support live investment decisions.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: BYU Silver Fund is one of the oldest and largest student-run investment funds in the United States, managed entirely by students across finance, accounting, economics, mathematics, and computer science under faculty supervision in the Marriott School of Business. Students conduct original research, make live investment decisions, and are directly accountable for fund performance. Alumni of the program have gone on to leadership roles across top firms in the finance industry.

As a Full Stack Engineer, I maintain and extend a production-grade investment analytics platform that supports multiple student-managed funds, including an undergraduate fundamental fund, a graduate fundamental fund, and a quantitative fund. The platform is used weekly by portfolio managers and analysts to evaluate performance, analyze time-series data, and support investment decisions.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
list: Maintain and manage four core repositories that collectively power the Silver Fund analytics platform, ensuring reliability, consistency, and clean integration across backend services, data pipelines, and frontend dashboards.

Design and implement backend features using FastAPI and PostgreSQL, including a data download project that enables users to export time-series performance data as CSV files for external analysis and reporting.

Work directly with the production database, writing and optimizing queries and supporting data processing pipelines using Polars to handle portfolio returns, benchmarks, and historical performance data.
Contribute to frontend development by improving UI and UX across dashboards, including interactive charts, tables, filters, and CSV download functionality used by portfolio managers.
Collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary engineering team through weekly team meetings, shared planning, and coordinated development cycles to deliver features aligned with fund needs.
Participate in structured Git workflows by reviewing pull requests, providing technical feedback, and submitting PRs to maintain code quality and consistency across the codebase.

sections.title: Frontend & User Experience Contributions
list: Built and enhanced dashboard features such as performance charts, data tables, filtering controls, and CSV export actions.
Improved usability and clarity of investment dashboards to support faster analysis and cleaner presentation of fund performance data.
Customized the AWS Amplify authentication and security interface using CSS to better match the platform’s design and improve the login and account security experience.

Leading the redesign of the platform’s user interface in Figma to create a more intuitive and user-friendly experience across investment dashboards, analytics tools, and portfolio management workflows.
Implemented UI updates that aligned frontend behavior with backend data changes and new analytics features.

sections.title: Engineering Practices & Infrastructure
list: Platform is hosted on AWS, with exposure to production cloud infrastructure and environment configuration.
Work with live databases and real investment data in a controlled production environment.
Participate in regular code reviews, pull request discussions, and team design decisions.
Engage in weekly team meetings to plan work, discuss issues, and align engineering priorities with fund needs.

sections.title: Technologies Used
paragraphs: FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, Polars, AWS, AWS Amplify, Git, GitHub, Linux, Figma

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Served as an IT Help Desk Technician supporting students, faculty, and staff within the BYU College of Life Sciences. The role required diagnosing and resolving a wide range of technical issues in a fast-paced academic environment while maintaining clear communication and professional customer support.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
list: Provided technical support for hardware, software, and basic networking issues affecting over 200 students and faculty members across the college.
Diagnosed and resolved issues related to Windows and macOS systems, peripherals, user accounts, and classroom technology.
Communicated technical solutions clearly to non-technical users, ensuring issues were fully understood and properly resolved.
Managed and tracked support requests using a ticketing and escalation system, prioritizing issues based on urgency and impact.
Identified recurring technical problems and contributed to timely, repeatable solutions to reduce future support requests.

sections.title: Technical Skills & Tools
paragraphs: System troubleshooting, networking fundamentals, Windows & macOS support, ticketing systems, technical documentation, user support workflows

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Supported district-wide IT operations for Nye County School District during a summer infrastructure upgrade period. Worked alongside full-time IT staff to deploy new network equipment, maintain systems, and ensure continuity of services across multiple school sites.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
list: Deployed and configured over 15 network switches across district locations, ensuring proper connectivity and integration with existing network architecture.
Integrated new networking hardware with legacy infrastructure, troubleshooting compatibility issues and minimizing downtime during upgrades.
Assisted with system administration tasks including daily backups, user account management, and routine hardware and software troubleshooting.
Documented IT workflows and created step-by-step support guides to improve onboarding efficiency and knowledge transfer for future staff and interns.

sections.title: Technical Skills & Tools
paragraphs: Networking fundamentals, system administration, backups, user account management, technical documentation, troubleshooting

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Native Scripture is a scripture publishing company focused on producing dual-language scripture resources to support language learning and accessibility. During this on-campus internship, I worked as part of a small project team supporting strategic, research, and technical initiatives in collaboration with organizational sponsors.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
list: Met weekly with a cross-functional student team to plan project milestones, coordinate tasks, and review progress with Native Scripture sponsors.
Researched and compiled a list of potential influencers and partners aligned with Native Scripture's mission, then ranked candidates based on reach, relevance, and collaboration potential.
Supported outreach efforts by organizing contact information and assisting with structured communication strategies for partnership and collaboration requests.
Conducted research on scripture publishing rights and licensing considerations across different languages to support international expansion and compliance.
Built an automated email reply workflow using n8n to streamline responses and improve efficiency in handling inbound communications.

sections.title: Technical & Professional Skills Applied
paragraphs: Workflow automation (n8n), research and analysis, stakeholder communication, documentation, project planning, team collaboration

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Served as a Security Guard at the Missionary Training Center, responsible for maintaining safety and security across a large, multi-building campus. The role required constant situational awareness, accurate documentation, and effective coordination with team members in a high-responsibility environment.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
list: Monitored and operated four networked surveillance systems covering 21 buildings, ensuring continuous visibility across the campus.
Used real-time video monitoring tools, analytics, and alert systems to identify and respond to suspicious or unusual activity.
Documented incidents and daily activity through detailed digital logs and formal incident reports.
Coordinated with other security personnel to respond to incidents and maintain consistent security coverage.

sections.title: Skills & Competencies
paragraphs: Security operations, surveillance systems, incident reporting, attention to detail, teamwork, situational awareness
